# WeightPlay

> Free online games that open in a browser on a phone or computer.

WeightPlay is developed and maintained by WeightStudio. Choose a game and play
without a download or account. A game's page explains its rules and controls.
Games with local saves keep progress in the current browser.

## Game audiences

The main lobby offers puzzles, solitaire, action, RPGs and other browser games.
The Kids lobby groups games for children and families by age and activity.

## Content Safety

Kids games are ad-free. Scores and skill reports describe in-game progress.
The [contact page](https://weightplay.com/contact.html) handles game feedback.
